display.purpose: The single h1 per page, in the hero and page heroes. Weight 300, max 11-16ch.

headline.purpose: Section h2s (SectionHeading) and the closing panel title.

title.purpose: Card, service, member and plan names; 1.25-2.25rem, weight 500.

lead.purpose: Muted sentence under every display or headline, 46-60ch.

body.purpose: Descriptions, FAQ answers and legal text at max 62-68ch; 15-16px.

label.purpose: Uppercase Geist Mono at 0.08em: nav links, nav contact pill, carousel hostnames only.

data.purpose: Tabular Geist Mono for stats, prices, step numbers, years, clause numbers and counters.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The hero project carousel floating over the canvas. Nothing on the theme ground casts a shadow.

motion.name: out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for arrows, rotations, image zoom, menu and accordion entry.

motion.name: fx-rise
motion.value: fx-rise 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; from opacity 0.4, translateY(14px), blur(4px)
motion.purpose: Hero and page-hero entry; content is already visible and only rises into focus. Staggered 0/120/240/360ms.

motion.name: fx-fill
motion.value: fx-fill 4800ms linear forwards; scaleX(0) to scaleX(1)
motion.purpose: Carousel progress segment, synced to the 4.8s slide interval.

motion.name: duration-move
motion.purpose: Arrow translate and terminal rotate on hover.

motion.name: weave
motion.value: spokes 0-1100ms, rings 600-2700ms, extensions 1900-2800ms, nodes from 2200ms, pulses every 420ms after 2600ms (max 9)
motion.purpose: Ñandutí canvas draw-in and live pulses; static under prefers-reduced-motion, paused offscreen.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global prefers-reduced-motion guard; smooth scroll disabled.

narrative.overview:
Fluxo Web is drawn as a literal web: the Guaraní ñandutí lace woven from the circuit traces of the Fluxo logo. Every service, product and partner is a node on one network that the company runs end to end. The visual language is black, white and green, the brand colors the company owns, applied with discipline: near-black framed panels carry hairline white threads, and green appears only where something is solid, actionable or alive.

The page reads as a sequence of framed rooms on a quiet ground. A dark framed panel opens every page (the hero, with the woven canvas behind the text), open sections of type and threads follow on the theme ground, a single solid green field states the end-to-end promise, and a single dark framed panel closes each marketing page with one WhatsApp action. Density is low; type is large, light and tightly tracked; proof (live projects, partners, dates) carries the persuasion instead of decoration.

It rejects the indigo SaaS template (badge pill, blob gradient, three equal cards) and its neon-dark opposite: no glow, no gradient accents, no eyebrow labels.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded framed panels (28px) inset 8–12px from the viewport edge, the border language of every page.
A dark `night` surface that stays dark in both themes, carrying the ñandutí canvas.
Hairline threads (1px, ink at 10–15% alpha) as dividers, timelines and connectors between round terminal nodes.
Green as solid committed fields, primary pills and live nodes; never as glow.
Light display type (300) with tight negative tracking; Geist Mono reserved for data.

rules.name: The Solid Green Rule
rules.body: Green is a fill, a node or a word of ink; it is never a glow, gradient, blur halo or colored shadow. If green needs to feel brighter, it becomes a bigger solid field.

rules.name: The Night Holds Rule
rules.body: Night panels stay dark in both themes. Theme switching changes the ground and the cards around them, never the framed panels that carry the web.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Page h1s are weight 300; headlines are 400; nothing above 500 appears anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets only numbers, hostnames, clause numbers and the nav labels. It never sets sentences, headings or labels above headings.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone: a title and its lead, stacked. No kicker, eyebrow or small-caps label sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the theme ground casts a shadow. Cards separate by a hairline border or a solid fill.

dos: Do open every page with a Night framed panel (28px radius, 8–12px inset); marketing pages end with exactly one closing panel holding one WhatsApp action, while legal documents end on the document itself.
Do keep Night panels dark in both themes and verify every other surface in light and dark.
Do use Circuit Green as a solid field, a pill fill or a lit node, with Ink on Green on top.
Do set page h1s at weight 300 with -0.035em tracking, and pair every heading with a muted lead.
Do use Geist Mono with tabular figures for numbers, hostnames, years, prices and clause numbers.
Do join related items with a hairline thread and round terminal nodes.
Do keep copy in neutral Latin American Spanish (tú: "Escríbenos", "Cuéntanos") and show only verifiable figures: founding year, number of partners, projects actually listed.
donts: Don't use green as glow, gradient, blur halo or colored shadow.
Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't set sentences or headings in Geist Mono.
Don't add shadows to cards on the ground; only the floating carousel casts one.
Don't use voseo ("Contanos", "Tenés") or invented stats, testimonials or client logos.
Don't use weights above 500 or square corners on interactive controls.
